title: Purple Jester Character Poses
description: Three sequential poses of a stylized male character with pale skin, white spiky hair, purple horns, and a demonic jester aesthetic. He wears a purple and white outfit with spiral patterns, skull motifs, a cat-like mask on his shoulder, and black-purple sandals. The views show him in dynamic stances from left profile to three-quarter and full action pose against a plain gray background.
prompt: A male demonic jester character with pale white skin, sharp teeth, purple and black horns, and wild white hair in a topknot. He wears a form-fitting white and purple outfit with spiral patterns, skull belt buckle, purple sash, and a small cat skull on his shoulder. Shown in three different dynamic action poses on a neutral gray background, digital character design, clean cel-shaded style with bold outlines.
